ezekiel.40.p1.b1.text: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile … in the fourteenth year after Jerusalem had been struck down … the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He took me there.

ezekiel.40.p1.b2.text: In visions of God He took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose southern slope was a structure that resembled a city.

ezekiel.40.p1.b3.text: … I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze. He was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.

ezekiel.40.p1.b4.text: Son of man … look with your eyes, hear with your ears, and pay attention to everything I am going to show you … Report to the house of Israel everything you see.

ezekiel.40.p2.b1.text: And I saw a wall surrounding the temple area. … Now the length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits … he measured the wall to be one rod thick and one rod high.

ezekiel.40.p2.b2.text: Then he came to the gate facing east and climbed its steps. …

ezekiel.40.p2.b3.text: Then he brought me into the outer court, and there were chambers and a pavement laid out all around the court. Thirty chambers faced the pavement

ezekiel.40.p2.b4.text: … The porticos also had windows all around on the inside. … Each side pillar was decorated with palm trees.

ezekiel.40.p3.b1.text: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees. Eight steps led up to it.

ezekiel.40.p3.b2.text: … These are the sons of Zadok, the only Levites who may approach the LORD to minister before Him.

ezekiel.40.p3.b3.text: Next he measured the court. It was square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.

ezekiel.40.p3.b4.text: Then he brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the side pillars of the portico …
